title: Airbnb: Strangers in Your Home
description: One-minute skill: Airbnb: Strangers in Your Home.

hook.text: Two designers couldn't afford rent, so they rented air mattresses to conference attendees.

buildup.text: Airbnb turned spare rooms and empty apartments into a global hospitality network.

discovery.text: Reviews and verification created enough trust for strangers to sleep in each other's homes.

twist.text: Airbnb disrupted hotels but also drove up rents in popular cities, sparking backlash.

climax.text: Airbnb proved that trust systems could unlock massive idle assets — bedrooms worldwide.

punchline.text: An air mattress became a $100 billion hospitality company.

quiz.question: How did Airbnb begin?
options: Founders rented air mattresses to afford rent
A hotel chain launched an app
